scripts.build: npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/protocol && npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/core && npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/react && npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/standalone
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q python/tests

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/protocol && npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/core && npm run build -w @dolphin-terminal/react && npm run typecheck -w @dolphin-terminal/standalone
